channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: IRGC threatens retaliation after US strike on Iranian island
item.description: Iran's IRGC threatens retaliation after a US strike on Larak Island kills two people and targets Iranian launchers preparing to deploy sea mines.

item.title: Advisory Committee rules: Eisenkot to receive security through Election Day
item.description: Advisory committee recommends protection for Gadi Eisenkot until election day after new findings, reversing a decision that sparked controversy.

item.title: Israel Dog Unit joins IDF Haruv unit in intense overnight drill
item.description: IDU handlers and specialized search dogs trained alongside Haruv soldiers in a challenging northern Israel exercise designed to prepare for complex scenarios in hostile terrain.

item.title: Hashivenu
item.description: It is Elul. And the voice of prayer merges with the early morning sound of a shofar, echoes in the sound of the bird singing on my porch rail this morning.

item.title: Rabbis rally behind Rabbi Dov Lior against former Chief Rabbi
item.description: A leading Religious Zionist rabbinic group condemns public remarks against Rabbi Dov Lior after Rabbi Yitzchak Yosef targeted him for scathing public critique.

item.title: Rosh Hashanah in the Land of Israel
item.description: One who observes carefully can see that God’s Kingship is being revealed more and more in our time.

item.title: Lebanese reports of Israeli strikes in Kfar Roummane and Qantara in southern Lebanon
item.description: Lebanese reports of Israeli strikes in Kfar Roummane and Qantara in southern Lebanon

item.title: US official: US forces struck Iranian launchers that were about to launch mines into Hormuz
item.description:
Axios cited a US official who said that earlier in the day, US forces struck two Iranian launchers on Larak Island.
According to the official, Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps forces were observed preparing to launch rockets with sea mines into the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Netanyahu confirms: 'I met with Winter and offered him 'Come to us, and you'll be welcomed''
item.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu confirmed in an interview with Channel 14 that he met with Ofer Winter. Netanyahu said that he "offered him, 'Come to us, and you'll be welcomed.' He chose to a seperate path and we're in trouble.'

item.title: Netanyahu: 'Very existence of State of Israel at stake in this election'
item.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu was interviewed on Channel 14 on Sunday evening and said, “The very existence of the State of Israel is at stake in this election."

item.title: Advisory committee recommends Shin Bet protection for Gadi Eisenkot
item.description: Advisory committee recommends Shin Bet protection for Gadi Eisenkot

item.title: Secret meeting: Netanyahu's offer to Winter
item.description: Report says Ofer Winter rejected Netanyahu’s offer of reserved Likud slots before launching his own party; despite backing Netanyahu, Likud remains wary.

item.title: Poll: Winter takes weakens Netanyahu, Ben-Gvir
item.description: Kan News poll gives Ofir Winter’s new party four seats, while Netanyahu edges Bennett for premiership and neither political bloc reaches 61.

item.title: Soldiers jailed after refusing to ride in APC with female medic
item.description: Three Hesder soldiers were sentenced to 10 days in military prison after refusing to board a Namer with a female medic, sparking fierce backlash from rabbis and politicians.

item.title: A Turkish flag on Route 60? Zvi Yehezkeli sees a ‘big message’
item.description: Arab affairs pundit Zvi Yehezkeli spots a Turkish flag on a Palestinian vehicle near Jerusalem and warns of growing admiration for Erdogan.

item.title: Israeli sovereignty demands taking back our universities from the left
item.description: The new academic year begins soon. This is the time to insist that University professors teach our students the same Jewish and Zionist values held by the Israeli taxpayers and Jewish donors who pay their salaries. Opinion.

item.title: Report: Tanker attacked while entering Strait of Hormuz
item.description:
UKMTO is reporting that a tanker was struck by an unknown projectile whilst transiting inbound in the Strait of Hormuz, 12 NM north of Khasab, Oman.
No casualties or environmental impact are reported at this time.
Authorities are investigating.

item.title: Former US Ambassador defends Israelis in Qusra incident
item.description: Former US ambassador to Israel David Friedman tweeted in response to the reports of clashes between Israelis and Palestinians in the town of Qusra over Shabbat.

item.title: A Covenant of Blood
item.description: Who are the Druze? They are Arab in language, culture, and DNA, but It is their religion that is unique. And what is the covenant of blood? Op-ed.

item.title: Israeli spokesman: 'The 'Qusra siege' is a propaganda campaign, not reality'
item.description: In this video, Israeli spokesman Ezra Tubi exposes how the story of Qusra fits into a familiar pattern of strategic propaganda.

item.title: Smotrich takes on fuel price hike with last-minute tax cut
item.description: Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich orders an excise tax cut to offset a planned 16-agura fuel price hike, with the reduction expected within days.

item.title: Yisrael Beytenu to unveil Knesset slate next week
item.description: Yisrael Beytenu will present its slate for the Knesset elections next week during an event at Expo Tel Aviv.

item.title: Why Israel’s August storm fizzled
item.description: Forecasters expected an unusual late-August storm, but the system shifted north and spared central Israel. Meteo-Tech’s chief forecaster explains what happened.

item.title: Slovenian leaders clash over Israel: ‘We are decision-makers, not servants’
item.description: Slovenian leaders trade barbs over Israel and EU policy, as PM Janez Janša rejects pressure from Brussels and wins praise from Netanyahu.

item.title: Secret document to Hegseth: 'We will carry out the orders, but at a price'
item.description: Senior US military leaders reportedly warn that prolonged operations against Iran are straining forces and could weaken readiness against threats elsewhere.

item.title: Jewish prayer returns to Temple Mount’s Eastern Wall
item.description: Weekly Slichot services are taking hold at the Temple Mount’s eastern wall as organizers seek to renew Jewish prayer at the ancient Jerusalem site.

item.title: United Airlines to resume Tel Aviv-San Francisco flights in March
item.description: United Airlines announces return of year-round nonstop service between Tel Aviv and San Francisco, as part of expansion of its Israel-US flight schedule.

item.title: Hasidic rabbis set to meet Trump at White House
item.description: Prominent Hasidic rabbis are reportedly set to meet President Trump at the White House, where the Satmar Rebbe plans to raise Israel’s yeshiva draft issue.
